failingTests: every read answers the owner and nobody else: the same call by another subject is the one refusal
a foreign target, an expired one, an ended one and one that never existed are the same refusal and cost the same work
creating: the owner is the subject, ids are server-made and checked, and the quota and every bound refuse without an effect
updating, cancelling and deleting follow the state of the run, and deleting a run removes its exports
a batch is atomic: any refusal or conflict discards every operation, and foreign targets are refused wherever they stand
ended, expired and moved leases: reaping frees the share, the operator sees only live leases, a move changes who owns it
